methodologyText: Clearance rates are calculated as total disposed cases divided by total added cases across reported months in the selected range, grouped into four sequential tiers (<80%, 80%–99.9%, 100%–119.9%, and ≥120%). Counties reporting fewer than 50% of expected monthly periods are classified as Insufficient Data and excluded from clearance rate tiers rather than plotted as 0%. In the county trendline drawer, missing or non-numeric entries (such as DNR, N/A, TI, or blanks) break the line rather than being interpolated or treated as zero.
